summary: Every name is famous and the title now says streams count, but a casual player finds 9 of 10, too easy for Today's list. As a Blitz it is excellent.
reasons: The title and prompt now name the measure (certified sales and streams), so Drake at #1 and the Beatles at #11 land as a fair surprise, and every miss shows its figure.

Classic is too easy and swingy: the casual found 9 of 10 (out of lives on guess 15), the fan only 6 (out after 11, on Beatles, Elvis, Kanye, Bruno Mars, Ed Sheeran). #7 to #13 sit within 7%, so guess order matters more than knowledge.
Deep Blitz: 129 well-known artists carry a figure, and 27 of the casual's 28 names scored (Bad Bunny isn't on the page).
fixes: Common shorthand gets no credit (free in classic, but scores nothing in Blitz): add "MJ" for Michael Jackson, "RHCP" for Red Hot Chili Peppers (now rejected as junk) and "Led Zep" for Led Zeppelin.
